subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should native subagent completion routing become a public `sessions_spawn` argument plus global and per-agent defaults, with `channel` retained as the compatibility default and no channel fallback in `parent` mode?
rationale: The implementation is sound, but the permanent model-facing, configuration, persistence, and failure-semantics contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the full contract
options.body: Reopen and land the per-spawn argument, both config defaults, and persisted target with `channel` as the unchanged default.

options.title: Sponsor per-spawn only
options.body: Reopen a narrower version that provides caller-selectable routing without adding global and per-agent defaults.

options.title: Decline native routing
options.body: Keep current behavior and leave orchestration to explicit callback or session-send patterns.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full contract
recommendation.body: Reopen and land the per-spawn argument, both config defaults, and persisted target with `channel` as the unchanged default.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the native sessions_spawn public contract and is the strongest available owner for deciding its permanent shape.
